)

func coldTestObserver(t *testing.T) *coldObserver {
	t.Helper()
	parent := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "owner")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(parent); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	directory := filepath.Join(parent, "evidence")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	opts := options{RunID: "observer-run", SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("a", 40), FixtureNonce: strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		Volume: "observer-volume", StateFile: filepath.Join(directory, "state.json")}
	content := []byte("sentinel\x00content\n")
	state := probeState{RunID: opts.RunID, SourceSHA: opts.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: opts.FixtureNonce, Volume: opts.Volume,
		RootID: 13, SentinelName: "sentinel.bin", Content: content, ContentSHA256: digest(content),
		Reference: storage.ReferenceState{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 0x0102030405060708, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: int64(len(content)),
			Metadata: map[string]storage.OpaquePayload{"fixture.current": {Version: []byte{1}, Data: []byte("metadata")}}}}}
	observer, err := newColdObserver(opts, state)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = observer.Close() })
	return observer
}

func coldTestError(o *coldObserver) error {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	return o.first
}

func coldTestEvents(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver) []map[string]any {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(o.options.StateFile), "cold-observations.jsonl"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var events []map[string]any
	for {
		var envelope struct {
			RunID        string         `json:"run_id"`
			SourceSHA    string         `json:"source_sha"`
			FixtureNonce string         `json:"fixture_nonce"`
			Event        map[string]any `json:"event"`
		}
		if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return events
		} else if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if envelope.RunID != o.options.RunID || envelope.SourceSHA != o.options.SourceSHA || envelope.FixtureNonce != o.options.FixtureNonce {
			t.Fatalf("unbound evidence: %+v", envelope)
		}
		events = append(events, envelope.Event)
	}
}

type coldTestRoundTripper func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f coldTestRoundTripper) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }

type coldTestBody struct {
	reader   io.Reader
	readErr  error
	closeErr error
	reads    int
	closes   int
}

func (b *coldTestBody) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	b.reads++
	n, err := b.reader.Read(p)
	if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) && b.readErr != nil {
		err = b.readErr
	}
	return n, err
}
func (b *coldTestBody) Close() error { b.closes++; return b.closeErr }

func coldTestHTTP(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver, request any, response any) {
	t.Helper()
	requestBytes, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	responseBytes, err := json.Marshal(response)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://fixture.invalid/v1/file", bytes.NewReader(requestBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	body := &coldTestBody{reader: bytes.NewReader(responseBytes)}
	calls := 0
	base := coldTestRoundTripper(func(got *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		calls++
		data, err := io.ReadAll(got.Body)
		if err != nil || got != r || !bytes.Equal(data, requestBytes) || got.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
			t.Fatalf("request changed: data=%q err=%v same=%t", data, err, got == r)
		}
		return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Header: http.Header{"Fixture": {"kept"}}, Body: body}, nil
	})
	got, err := o.Transport(base).RoundTrip(r)
	if err != nil || calls != 1 || body.reads != 0 || body.closes != 0 || got.Header.Get("Fixture") != "kept" {
		t.Fatalf("RoundTrip changed delivery: err=%v calls=%d reads=%d closes=%d", err, calls, body.reads, body.closes)
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(got.Body)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(data, responseBytes) {
		t.Fatalf("response changed: data=%q err=%v", data, err)
	}
	if err := got.Body.Close(); err != nil || body.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("response close: err=%v calls=%d", err, body.closes)
	}
}

func coldTestHTTPOpen(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver) {
	t.Helper()
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.session-open"}, coldHTTPResponse{Session: "session"})
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, map[string]any{"op": "file.open-at", "session": "session",
		"child": storage.ChildName{Parent: storage.DirectoryTarget{NodeID: o.state.RootID}, RawLeaf: []byte(o.state.SentinelName)}},
		coldHTTPResponse{File: "reference", Attr: httprest.AttrOf(o.state.Reference.Attr)})
}

func coldTestHTTPReadAndClose(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver) {
	t.Helper()
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.read", Session: "session", File: "reference", Length: len(o.state.Content)},
		coldHTTPResponse{Attr: httprest.AttrOf(o.state.Reference.Attr), Data: o.state.Content})
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.close", Session: "session", File: "reference"}, coldHTTPResponse{})
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.session-close", Session: "session"}, coldHTTPResponse{})
}

func TestColdObserverBindingAndEvidenceBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []string{"run", "source", "nonce", "volume", "identity", "content"} {
		t.Run(field, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			state := o.state
			switch field {
			case "run":
				state.RunID = "other"
			case "source":
				state.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("c", 40)
			case "nonce":
				state.FixtureNonce = strings.Repeat("d", 64)
			case "volume":
				state.Volume = "other"
			case "identity":
				state.Reference.Attr.ID = 0
			case "content":
				state.ContentSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
			}
			if _, err := newColdObserver(o.options, state); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "bound probe") {
				t.Fatalf("invalid %s binding accepted: %v", field, err)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("exclusive-log", func(t *testing.T) {
		o := coldTestObserver(t)
		if _, err := newColdObserver(o.options, o.state); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
			t.Fatalf("existing evidence replaced: %v", err)
		}
	})
	for _, name := range []string{"record", "trace", "json", "closed"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			event := map[string]any{"kind": "native", "file_id": "opaque"}
			switch name {
			case "record":
				event["payload"] = strings.Repeat("x", coldRecordLimit)
			case "trace":
				o.written = coldTraceLimit - 1
			case "json":
				event["invalid"] = make(chan struct{})
			case "closed":
				if err := o.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if err := o.Record(event); err == nil || coldTestError(o) == nil || o.Validate() == nil || o.Close() == nil {
				t.Fatalf("failed evidence accepted: %v", err)
			}
			if events := coldTestEvents(t, o); len(events) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("failed record left partial evidence: %+v", events)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPPassthroughAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	coldTestHTTPOpen(t, o)
	if !o.httpOpen || len(o.httpSessions) != 1 || len(o.httpRefs) != 1 || o.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("retained open or missing evidence was misclassified")
	}
	coldTestHTTPReadAndClose(t, o)
	if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil || !o.httpRead || len(o.httpSessions) != 0 || len(o.httpRefs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("HTTP lifecycle evidence: error=%v sessions=%v references=%v", err, o.httpSessions, o.httpRefs)
	}
	events := coldTestEvents(t, o)
	if len(events) != 5 || events[2]["digest"] != digest(o.state.Content) || events[2]["backend_node_id"] != json.Number(strconv.FormatUint(o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, 10)) {
		t.Fatalf("read evidence=%+v", events)
	}
	if err := o.Close(); err != nil || o.Close() != nil {
		t.Fatalf("close: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPBodyCloseFailureAfterEOF(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	closeFailure := errors.New("response close failed")
	body := &coldTestBody{reader: strings.NewReader(`{"session":"session"}`), closeErr: closeFailure}
	r, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://fixture.invalid/file-control", strings.NewReader(`{"op":"file.session-open"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	transport := o.Transport(coldTestRoundTripper(func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Body: body}, nil
	}))
	response, err := transport.RoundTrip(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("complete response failed before Close: %v", err)
	}
	if err := response.Body.Close(); err != closeFailure {
		t.Fatalf("Close lost original error: %v", err)
	}
	if err := coldTestError(o); !errors.Is(err, closeFailure) {
		t.Fatalf("EOF-then-Close failure missing from observation: %v", err)
	}
	if o.Validate() == nil || o.Close() == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed HTTP cleanup reported successful evidence")
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPObservationFailureDoesNotChangeTransport(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"missing-copy", "copy-error", "copy-close-error", "oversized-request", "invalid-request", "long-request-id"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			payload := `{"op":"file.session-open"}`
			switch name {
			case "oversized-request":
				payload = strings.Repeat(" ", coldHTTPLimit) + payload
			case "invalid-request":
				payload = "{"
			case "long-request-id":
				payload = `{"op":"file.read","session":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 257) + `"}`
			}
			r, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://fixture.invalid/file", strings.NewReader(payload))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			failure := errors.New("body copy failed")
			switch name {
			case "missing-copy":
				r.GetBody = nil
			case "copy-error":
				r.GetBody = func() (io.ReadCloser, error) { return nil, failure }
			case "copy-close-error":
				r.GetBody = func() (io.ReadCloser, error) {
					return &coldTestBody{reader: strings.NewReader(payload), closeErr: failure}, nil
				}
			}
			calls := 0
			transport := o.Transport(coldTestRoundTripper(func(got *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				calls++
				data, err := io.ReadAll(got.Body)
				if err != nil || string(data) != payload || got != r {
					t.Fatalf("transport request was consumed or replaced: %v", err)
				}
				return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("unavailable"))}, nil
			}))
			response, err := transport.RoundTrip(r)
			if err != nil || calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("observer changed transport outcome: %v calls=%d", err, calls)
			}
			data, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			if err != nil || string(data) != "unavailable" || response.StatusCode != http.StatusServiceUnavailable {
				t.Fatalf("transport response changed: %q %v", data, err)
			}
			if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil {
				t.Fatal("request observation failure was lost")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"partial", "oversized", "read-error", "invalid-json", "long-response-id", "missing-body"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			payload := `{"session":"session"}`
			switch name {
			case "oversized":
				payload = strings.Repeat(" ", coldHTTPLimit) + payload
			case "invalid-json":
				payload = "{"
			case "long-response-id":
				payload = `{"session":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 257) + `"}`
			}
			failure := errors.New("network read failed")
			body := &coldTestBody{reader: strings.NewReader(payload)}
			if name == "read-error" {
				body.readErr = failure
			}
			r, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://fixture.invalid/file", strings.NewReader(`{"op":"file.session-open"}`))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			transport := o.Transport(coldTestRoundTripper(func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				response := &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Body: body}
				if name == "missing-body" {
					response.Body = nil
				}
				return response, nil
			}))
			response, err := transport.RoundTrip(r)
			if err != nil || body.reads != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("response was read before delivery: %v reads=%d", err, body.reads)
			}
			if response.Body != nil {
				if name == "partial" {
					if _, err := response.Body.Read(make([]byte, 1)); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				} else {
					data, readErr := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
					if string(data) != payload || (name == "read-error" && readErr != failure) || (name != "read-error" && readErr != nil) {
						t.Fatalf("response body changed: bytes=%d error=%v", len(data), readErr)
					}
				}
				if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil || len(o.httpSessions) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("failed response credited a session: %+v", o.httpSessions)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPUnobservedAndTransportErrorsPassThrough(t *testing.T) {
	for _, path := range []string{"/capabilities", "/file"} {
		t.Run(path, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			r, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://fixture.invalid"+path, strings.NewReader(`{"op":"file.read"}`))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			failure := errors.New("round trip failed")
			original := &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusBadGateway, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("upstream"))}
			transport := o.Transport(coldTestRoundTripper(func(got *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				if got != r {
					t.Fatal("request identity changed")
				}
				return original, failure
			}))
			response, err := transport.RoundTrip(r)
			if response != original || err != failure {
				t.Fatalf("transport result changed: %p %v", response, err)
			}
			if err := original.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			events := coldTestEvents(t, o)
			if path == "/capabilities" && len(events) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unobserved endpoint recorded: %+v", events)
			}
			if path == "/file" && (len(events) != 1 || events[0]["transport_error"] != failure.Error()) {
				t.Fatalf("transport error evidence=%+v", events)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPRejectsIdentityAndDataChanges(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"open-id", "read-id", "reference", "bytes", "short-read", "size", "metadata", "negative-offset", "negative-length"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			if name == "open-id" {
				attr := o.state.Reference.Attr
				attr.ID++
				coldTestHTTP(t, o, map[string]any{"op": "file.open-at", "session": "session", "child": storage.ChildName{Parent: storage.DirectoryTarget{NodeID: o.state.RootID}, RawLeaf: []byte(o.state.SentinelName)}}, coldHTTPResponse{File: "reference", Attr: httprest.AttrOf(attr)})
			} else {
				coldTestHTTPOpen(t, o)
				request := coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.read", Session: "session", File: "reference", Length: len(o.state.Content)}
				attr := o.state.Reference.Attr
				data := bytes.Clone(o.state.Content)
				switch name {
				case "read-id":
					attr.ID++
				case "reference":
					request.File = "unknown"
				case "bytes":
					data[0] ^= 1
				case "short-read":
					data = data[:len(data)-1]
				case "size":
					attr.Size++
				case "metadata":
					attr.Metadata = nil
				case "negative-offset":
					request.Offset = -1
				case "negative-length":
					request.Length = -1
				}
				coldTestHTTP(t, o, request, coldHTTPResponse{Attr: httprest.AttrOf(attr), Data: data})
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil || o.httpRead {
				t.Fatal("mismatched authoritative result was credited")
			}
		})
	}
}

type coldTestAddr string

func (a coldTestAddr) Network() string { return "memory" }
func (a coldTestAddr) String() string  { return string(a) }

type coldTestConn struct {
	input    io.Reader
	output   bytes.Buffer
	writeMax int
	writeErr error
	closeErr error
	closes   int
}

func (c *coldTestConn) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if c.input == nil {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	return c.input.Read(p)
}
func (c *coldTestConn) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	n := len(p)
	if c.writeMax > 0 {
		n = min(n, c.writeMax)
	}
	_, _ = c.output.Write(p[:n])
	return n, c.writeErr
}
func (c *coldTestConn) Close() error                     { c.closes++; return c.closeErr }
func (c *coldTestConn) LocalAddr() net.Addr              { return coldTestAddr("server") }
func (c *coldTestConn) RemoteAddr() net.Addr             { return coldTestAddr("client") }
func (c *coldTestConn) SetDeadline(time.Time) error      { return nil }
func (c *coldTestConn) SetReadDeadline(time.Time) error  { return nil }
func (c *coldTestConn) SetWriteDeadline(time.Time) error { return nil }

type coldTestListener struct {
	conn net.Conn
	err  error
}

func (l coldTestListener) Accept() (net.Conn, error) { return l.conn, l.err }
func (coldTestListener) Close() error                { return nil }
func (coldTestListener) Addr() net.Addr              { return coldTestAddr("listener") }

func coldTestConnection(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver) (*coldWireConnection, *coldTestConn) {
	t.Helper()
	base := &coldTestConn{}
	conn, err := o.Listener(coldTestListener{conn: base}).Accept()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	observed, ok := conn.(*coldWireConnection)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("connection was not observed: %T", conn)
	}
	return observed, base
}

func coldTestPacket(command uint16, message uint64, out bool, body []byte) []byte {
	packet := make([]byte, 64+len(body))
	copy(packet, "\xfeSMB")
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[4:], 64)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[12:], command)
	if out {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[16:], 1)
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(packet[24:], message)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[36:], 29)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(packet[40:], 47)
	copy(packet[64:], body)
	return packet
}

func coldTestFrame(packets ...[]byte) []byte {
	var payload []byte
	for i, packet := range packets {
		part := bytes.Clone(packet)
		if i+1 < len(packets) {
			padded := (len(part) + 7) &^ 7
			part = append(part, make([]byte, padded-len(part))...)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(part[20:], uint32(padded))
		}
		payload = append(payload, part...)
	}
	frame := []byte{0, byte(len(payload) >> 16), byte(len(payload) >> 8), byte(len(payload))}
	return append(frame, payload...)
}

func coldTestName(name string) []byte {
	var data []byte
	for _, unit := range utf16.Encode([]rune(name)) {
		data = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint16(data, unit)
	}
	return data
}

func coldTestCreateRequest(message uint64, name string) []byte {
	data := coldTestName(name)
	body := make([]byte, 56+len(data))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 57)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[44:], 120)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[46:], uint16(len(data)))
	copy(body[56:], data)
	return coldTestPacket(5, message, false, body)
}

func coldTestQFID(o *coldObserver, node uint64) []byte {
	context := make([]byte, 64)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[4:], 16)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[6:], 4)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[10:], 24)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(context[12:], 32)
	copy(context[16:], "QFid")
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(context[24:], node)
	serial := sha256.Sum256([]byte("smb.volume-id.v1\x00" + o.options.Volume))
	copy(context[32:40], serial[:8])
	return context
}

func coldTestCreateResponse(o *coldObserver, message uint64, file []byte, node uint64, qfid bool) []byte {
	body := make([]byte, 88)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 89)
	copy(body[64:80], file)
	if qfid {
		context := coldTestQFID(o, node)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[80:], 152)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[84:], uint32(len(context)))
		body = append(body, context...)
	}
	return coldTestPacket(5, message, true, body)
}

func coldTestReadRequest(message uint64, file []byte, offset uint64, length uint32) []byte {
	body := make([]byte, 48)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 49)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], length)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(body[8:], offset)
	copy(body[16:32], file)
	return coldTestPacket(8, message, false, body)
}

func coldTestReadResponse(message uint64, data []byte) []byte {
	body := make([]byte, 16+len(data))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 17)
	body[2] = 80
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], uint32(len(data)))
	copy(body[16:], data)
	return coldTestPacket(8, message, true, body)
}

func coldTestQueryRequest(message uint64, file []byte, class byte) []byte {
	body := make([]byte, 40)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 41)
	body[2], body[3] = 1, class
	copy(body[24:40], file)
	return coldTestPacket(16, message, false, body)
}

func coldTestQueryResponse(message uint64, data []byte) []byte {
	body := make([]byte, 8+len(data))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body[2:], 72)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:], uint32(len(data)))
	copy(body[8:], data)
	return coldTestPacket(16, message, true, body)
}

func coldTestFileID(o *coldObserver, node uint64) []byte {
	serial := sha256.Sum256([]byte("smb.volume-id.v1\x00" + o.options.Volume))
	data := make([]byte, 24)
	copy(data, serial[:8])
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[8:], node)
	return data
}

func coldTestFeed(c *coldWireConnection, out bool, frame []byte, step int) {
	for len(frame) > 0 {
		n := min(step, len(frame))
		c.feed(out, frame[:n], nil)
		frame = frame[n:]
	}
}

func coldTestOpen(t *testing.T, o *coldObserver, c *coldWireConnection) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	file := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x5a}, 16)
	c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestCreateRequest(100, o.state.SentinelName)), nil)
	c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(coldTestCreateResponse(o, 100, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, true)), nil)
	if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return file
}

func TestColdSMBFragmentedCompoundAndOpaqueNativeEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
	coldTestHTTPOpen(t, o)
	coldTestHTTPReadAndClose(t, o)
	coldTestFeed(c, false, coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(1, 1, false, make([]byte, 24)), coldTestPacket(3, 2, false, make([]byte, 8))), 3)
	tree := make([]byte, 16)
	tree[2] = 1
	coldTestFeed(c, true, coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(1, 1, true, make([]byte, 8)), coldTestPacket(3, 2, true, tree)), 7)
	file, related := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42}, 16), bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
	requests := [][]byte{coldTestCreateRequest(3, o.state.SentinelName), coldTestReadRequest(4, related, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content))),
		coldTestQueryRequest(5, related, 6), coldTestQueryRequest(6, related, 59)}
	closeBody := make([]byte, 24)
	copy(closeBody[8:], related)
	requests = append(requests, coldTestPacket(6, 7, false, closeBody))
	for _, packet := range requests[1:] {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[16:], 4)
	}
	coldTestFeed(c, false, coldTestFrame(requests...), 1)
	responses := [][]byte{coldTestCreateResponse(o, 3, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, true), coldTestReadResponse(4, o.state.Content),
		coldTestQueryResponse(5, binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(nil, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID)),
		coldTestQueryResponse(6, coldTestFileID(o, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID)), coldTestPacket(6, 7, true, make([]byte, 60))}
	coldTestFeed(c, true, coldTestFrame(responses...), 11)
	if err := c.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeRecord := o.Record
	nativeID := strings.Repeat("f0", 16)
	if err := nativeRecord(map[string]any{"kind": "native", "api": "GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileIdInfo)", "native_file_id_hex": nativeID, "native_volume_serial_hex": "8877665544332211"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := o.Validate(); err != nil || len(c.pending) != 0 || len(c.opens) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("complete observation failed: %v pending=%v opens=%v", err, c.pending, c.opens)
	}
	foundInternal, foundFileID, foundQFID, foundNative := false, false, false, false
	for _, event := range coldTestEvents(t, o) {
		if value, ok := event["wire_internal_id"]; ok {
			foundInternal = value == json.Number(strconv.FormatUint(o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, 10))
		}
		if value, ok := event["wire_file_id"]; ok {
			foundFileID = value == hex.EncodeToString(coldTestFileID(o, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID)[8:])
		}
		if value, ok := event["wire_qfid_disk_id"]; ok {
			foundQFID = value == json.Number(strconv.FormatUint(o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, 10))
		}
		if event["kind"] == "native" {
			foundNative = event["native_file_id_hex"] == nativeID && event["native_volume_serial_hex"] == "8877665544332211"
		}
	}
	if !foundInternal || !foundFileID || !foundQFID || !foundNative {
		t.Fatalf("identity evidence: internal=%t file=%t qfid=%t native=%t", foundInternal, foundFileID, foundQFID, foundNative)
	}
}

func TestColdSMBRelatedCompoundInheritsExistingOpen(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"read-close", "query-info-read", "query-info-read-explicit-ignored-id"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			file := coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
			inherited := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
			if name == "query-info-read-explicit-ignored-id" {
				inherited = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xab}, 16)
			}
			first := coldTestReadRequest(1, file, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			firstResponse := coldTestReadResponse(1, o.state.Content)
			closeBody := make([]byte, 24)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(closeBody, 24)
			copy(closeBody[8:], inherited)
			second := coldTestPacket(6, 2, false, closeBody)
			secondResponse := coldTestPacket(6, 2, true, make([]byte, 60))
			if name != "read-close" {
				first = coldTestQueryRequest(1, file, 6)
				firstResponse = coldTestQueryResponse(1, binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(nil, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID))
				second = coldTestReadRequest(2, inherited, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
				secondResponse = coldTestReadResponse(2, o.state.Content)
			}
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(second[16:], 4)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(second[36:], ^uint32(0))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(second[40:], ^uint64(0))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(secondResponse[16:], 5)
			coldTestFeed(c, false, coldTestFrame(first, second), 5)
			if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("valid existing-open request inheritance rejected: %v", err)
			}
			coldTestFeed(c, true, coldTestFrame(firstResponse, secondResponse), 13)
			if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil || !o.smbRead || len(c.pending) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("existing-open response inheritance: err=%v read=%t pending=%v", err, o.smbRead, c.pending)
			}
			if name != "read-close" {
				if len(c.opens) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("READ changed open ownership: %+v", c.opens)
				}
				copy(closeBody[8:], file)
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(6, 3, false, closeBody)), nil)
				c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(6, 3, true, make([]byte, 60))), nil)
			}
			if err := c.Close(); err != nil || coldTestError(o) != nil || len(c.opens) != 0 || len(c.pending) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("inherited open cleanup: err=%v observation=%v opens=%v pending=%v", err, coldTestError(o), c.opens, c.pending)
			}
			readEvidence, identityEvidence := false, name == "read-close"
			for _, event := range coldTestEvents(t, o) {
				if event["command"] == json.Number("8") && event["response"] == true && event["digest"] == digest(o.state.Content) {
					readEvidence = true
				}
				if event["wire_internal_id"] == json.Number(strconv.FormatUint(o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, 10)) {
					identityEvidence = true
				}
			}
			if !readEvidence || !identityEvidence {
				t.Fatalf("inherited evidence missing: read=%t identity=%t", readEvidence, identityEvidence)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdSMBUnrelatedBoundaryClearsInheritedOpen(t *testing.T) {
	for _, predecessor := range []string{"create", "existing-read"} {
		t.Run(predecessor, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			file := coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
			first := coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName)
			inherited := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
			last := coldTestReadRequest(3, inherited, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			if predecessor == "existing-read" {
				first = coldTestReadRequest(1, file, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
				body := make([]byte, 24)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 24)
				copy(body[8:], inherited)
				last = coldTestPacket(6, 3, false, body)
			}
			echo := coldTestPacket(13, 2, false, []byte{4, 0, 0, 0})
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(last[16:], 4)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(last[36:], ^uint32(0))
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(last[40:], ^uint64(0))
			coldTestFeed(c, false, coldTestFrame(first, echo, last), 7)
			if coldTestError(o) == nil {
				t.Fatalf("unrelated ECHO retained the %s identity", predecessor)
			}
			if _, accepted := c.pending[3]; accepted || o.smbRead {
				t.Fatal("missing inherited identity was installed or credited")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdObserverConcurrentRecordsStayBoundAndWhole(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	var writers sync.WaitGroup
	for i := range 32 {
		writers.Go(func() {
			if err := o.Record(map[string]any{"kind": "native", "id": fmt.Sprintf("event-%d", i)}); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("record: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
	writers.Wait()
	if err := o.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	events := coldTestEvents(t, o)
	seen := make(map[any]bool)
	for _, event := range events {
		seen[event["id"]] = true
	}
	if len(events) != 32 || len(seen) != 32 {
		t.Fatalf("interleaved or missing records: count=%d distinct=%d", len(events), len(seen))
	}
}

func TestColdHTTPRetriesAndSessionCleanupDoNotInventReferences(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.session-open"}, coldHTTPResponse{Session: "unconfirmed", Retry: true})
	if len(o.httpSessions) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("retry response enrolled a session")
	}
	coldTestHTTPOpen(t, o)
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.open-node-ref", Session: "session"}, coldHTTPResponse{File: "unconfirmed", Retry: true})
	if len(o.httpRefs) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("retry response enrolled a reference")
	}
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.open-node-ref", Session: "session"}, coldHTTPResponse{File: "root", Attr: &httprest.Attr{ID: o.state.RootID, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}})
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.session-close", Session: "session"}, coldHTTPResponse{Retry: true})
	if len(o.httpSessions) != 1 || len(o.httpRefs) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("unconfirmed session close discarded retained references")
	}
	coldTestHTTP(t, o, coldHTTPRequest{Op: "file.session-close", Session: "session"}, coldHTTPResponse{})
	if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil || len(o.httpSessions) != 0 || len(o.httpRefs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("confirmed session close did not release all references: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestColdSMBRejectsMismatchedAndDuplicateResponses(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"unsolicited", "wrong-command", "duplicate-request", "duplicate-response", "wrong-session", "wrong-tree", "unknown-open", "wrong-data", "short-data", "short-body", "field-offset", "duplicate-open", "related-without-create", "related-before-create"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			file := coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
			request := coldTestReadRequest(1, file, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			response := coldTestReadResponse(1, o.state.Content)
			switch name {
			case "unsolicited":
				request = nil
			case "wrong-command":
				response = coldTestQueryResponse(1, make([]byte, 8))
			case "wrong-session":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(response[40:], 48)
			case "wrong-tree":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[36:], 30)
			case "unknown-open":
				request = coldTestReadRequest(1, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x81}, 16), 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			case "wrong-data":
				response[len(response)-1] ^= 1
			case "short-data":
				response = coldTestReadResponse(1, o.state.Content[:len(o.state.Content)-1])
			case "short-body":
				response = coldTestPacket(8, 1, true, make([]byte, 15))
			case "field-offset":
				response[66] = 79
			case "duplicate-open":
				request = coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName)
				response = coldTestCreateResponse(o, 1, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, false)
			case "related-without-create":
				request = coldTestReadRequest(1, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16), 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(request[16:], 4)
			case "related-before-create":
				request = coldTestReadRequest(2, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16), 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(request[16:], 4)
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName), request), nil)
				request = nil
				response = coldTestReadResponse(2, o.state.Content)
			}
			if request != nil {
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(request), nil)
			}
			if name == "duplicate-request" {
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(request), nil)
			}
			c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
			if name == "duplicate-response" {
				c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
			}
			first := coldTestError(o)
			if first == nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid %s exchange accepted", name)
			}
			c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
			if coldTestError(o) != first {
				t.Fatal("first observation failure changed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdSMBObservedIdentityQueriesAreExact(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"internal-node", "internal-length", "file-node", "file-volume", "file-upper-id", "file-length", "qfid-node", "qfid-volume", "qfid-reserved", "qfid-length", "qfid-offset"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "qfid-") {
				response := coldTestCreateResponse(o, 1, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x19}, 16), o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, true)
				switch name {
				case "qfid-node":
					response[176] ^= 1
				case "qfid-volume":
					response[184] ^= 1
				case "qfid-reserved":
					response[192] = 1
				case "qfid-length":
					binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[164:], 31)
				case "qfid-offset":
					binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[144:], 151)
				}
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName)), nil)
				c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
			} else {
				file := coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
				class := byte(59)
				data := coldTestFileID(o, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID)
				switch name {
				case "internal-node", "internal-length":
					class = 6
					data = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(nil, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID)
					if name == "internal-node" {
						data[0] ^= 1
					} else {
						data = append(data, 0)
					}
				case "file-node":
					data[8] ^= 1
				case "file-volume":
					data[0] ^= 1
				case "file-upper-id":
					data[16] = 1
				case "file-length":
					data = data[:23]
				}
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestQueryRequest(1, file, class)), nil)
				c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(coldTestQueryResponse(1, data)), nil)
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil {
				t.Fatalf("mismatched %s projection accepted", name)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdSMBRejectsPartialOversizedAndMalformedFrames(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"partial-eof", "partial-close", "oversized-frame", "oversized-buffer", "transport-kind", "smb-header", "header-length", "direction", "compound-offset", "compound-tail", "compound-count", "name-odd", "name-surrogate", "name-offset"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			packet := coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName)
			frame := coldTestFrame(packet)
			ended := error(nil)
			switch name {
			case "partial-eof":
				frame, ended = frame[:len(frame)-1], io.EOF
			case "partial-close":
				frame = frame[:3]
			case "oversized-frame":
				frame = []byte{0, byte((coldFrameLimit + 1) >> 16), byte(((coldFrameLimit + 1) >> 8) & 255), byte((coldFrameLimit + 1) & 255)}
			case "oversized-buffer":
				frame = make([]byte, coldFrameLimit+5)
			case "transport-kind":
				frame[0] = 0x81
			case "smb-header":
				frame[4] = 0xfd
			case "header-length":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(frame[8:], 63)
			case "direction":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(frame[20:], 1)
			case "compound-offset":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(frame[24:], 65)
			case "compound-tail":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(frame[24:], uint32(len(packet)))
			case "compound-count":
				var packets [][]byte
				for i := range 33 {
					packets = append(packets, coldTestPacket(1, uint64(i), false, nil))
				}
				frame = coldTestFrame(packets...)
			case "name-odd":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(frame[114:], 1)
			case "name-surrogate":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(frame[114:], 2)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(frame[124:], 0xd800)
			case "name-offset":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(frame[112:], 119)
			}
			c.feed(false, frame, ended)
			if name == "partial-close" {
				if err := c.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid %s frame accepted", name)
			}
		})
	}
	if got, err := coldName(coldTestName("dir\\α-😀.txt")); err != nil || got != "dir\\α-😀.txt" {
		t.Fatalf("valid UTF-16 name=%q err=%v", got, err)
	}
	if _, err := coldName(make([]byte, 4098)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("oversized UTF-16 name accepted")
	}
}

func TestColdSMBTransportPreservesPartialIOAndConnectionErrors(t *testing.T) {
	o := coldTestObserver(t)
	c, base := coldTestConnection(t, o)
	request := coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(1, 1, false, make([]byte, 24)))
	base.input = bytes.NewReader(request)
	var received bytes.Buffer
	buffer := make([]byte, 7)
	for {
		n, err := c.Read(buffer)
		received.Write(buffer[:n])
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(received.Bytes(), request) {
		t.Fatal("observed Read changed transport bytes")
	}
	response := coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(1, 1, true, make([]byte, 8)))
	base.writeMax = 5
	for remaining := response; len(remaining) > 0; {
		n, err := c.Write(remaining)
		if err != nil || n != min(5, len(remaining)) {
			t.Fatalf("partial Write changed n/error: %d %v", n, err)
		}
		remaining = remaining[n:]
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(base.output.Bytes(), response) || !o.smbSession || coldTestError(o) != nil {
		t.Fatal("partial writes changed SMB observation")
	}
	failure := errors.New("connection close failed")
	base.closeErr = failure
	if err := c.Close(); err != failure || base.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Close changed result: %v calls=%d", err, base.closes)
	}
	if _, err := o.Listener(coldTestListener{err: failure}).Accept(); err != failure {
		t.Fatalf("Accept changed result: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestColdSMBBoundsPendingAndConnectionObservations(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("pending", func(t *testing.T) {
		o := coldTestObserver(t)
		c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
		for i := range 256 {
			c.pending[uint64(i)] = coldWireRequest{command: 1}
		}
		c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(coldTestPacket(1, 257, false, nil)), nil)
		if coldTestError(o) == nil || len(c.pending) != 256 {
			t.Fatalf("pending bound: error=%v count=%d", coldTestError(o), len(c.pending))
		}
	})
	t.Run("connections", func(t *testing.T) {
		o := coldTestObserver(t)
		for range 16 {
			coldTestConnection(t, o)
		}
		base := &coldTestConn{}
		conn, err := o.Listener(coldTestListener{conn: base}).Accept()
		if err != nil || conn != base || coldTestError(o) == nil || len(o.connections) != 16 {
			t.Fatalf("connection bound changed transport: %v count=%d", err, len(o.connections))
		}
	})
}

func coldTestSetLineage(packet []byte, session uint64, tree uint32) {
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(packet[40:], session)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[36:], tree)
}

func TestColdSMBResponseLineageRejectsForeignHeaders(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"standalone", "related-create"} {
		for _, operation := range []string{"read", "query-info"} {
			for _, field := range []string{"session", "tree"} {
				t.Run(mode+"-"+operation+"-"+field, func(t *testing.T) {
					o := coldTestObserver(t)
					c, base := coldTestConnection(t, o)
					file := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x42}, 16)
					foreignSession, foreignTree := uint64(47), uint32(29)
					if field == "session" {
						foreignSession++
					} else {
						foreignTree++
					}
					var requests, responses [][]byte
					if mode == "standalone" {
						file = coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
						request := coldTestCreateRequest(101, o.state.SentinelName)
						response := coldTestCreateResponse(o, 101, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, false)
						coldTestSetLineage(request, foreignSession, foreignTree)
						coldTestSetLineage(response, foreignSession, foreignTree)
						c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(request), nil)
						c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
						if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
							t.Fatal(err)
						}
					} else {
						requests = append(requests, coldTestCreateRequest(3, o.state.SentinelName))
						responses = append(responses, coldTestCreateResponse(o, 3, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, false))
						file = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16)
					}
					request := coldTestReadRequest(4, file, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
					response := coldTestReadResponse(4, o.state.Content)
					if operation == "query-info" {
						request = coldTestQueryRequest(4, file, 6)
						response = coldTestQueryResponse(4, binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(nil, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID))
					}
					if mode == "related-create" {
						binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(request[16:], 4)
						coldTestSetLineage(request, ^uint64(0), ^uint32(0))
						binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[16:], 5)
					}
					coldTestSetLineage(response, foreignSession, foreignTree)
					requests = append(requests, request)
					responses = append(responses, response)
					c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(requests...), nil)
					if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					frame := coldTestFrame(responses...)
					if n, err := c.Write(frame); n != len(frame) || err != nil || !bytes.Equal(base.output.Bytes(), frame) {
						t.Fatalf("observer altered rejected response transport: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
					}
					first := coldTestError(o)
					if first == nil || o.smbRead {
						t.Fatal("same-MID foreign lineage was credited")
					}
					if _, pending := c.pending[4]; !pending {
						t.Fatal("mismatched response retired the bound request")
					}
					for _, event := range coldTestEvents(t, o) {
						if _, credited := event["wire_internal_id"]; credited {
							t.Fatal("foreign query response produced identity evidence")
						}
					}
					c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(coldTestReadResponse(99, nil)), nil)
					if coldTestError(o) != first {
						t.Fatal("later traffic replaced the first lineage error")
					}
				})
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestColdSMBRelatedAllocationUsesValidatedResponseLineage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"read-sentinel-headers", "query-ignored-headers", "failed-tree"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			tree := coldTestPacket(3, 1, false, make([]byte, 8))
			coldTestSetLineage(tree, 47, 0)
			create := coldTestCreateRequest(2, o.state.SentinelName)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(create[16:], 4)
			coldTestSetLineage(create, ^uint64(0), ^uint32(0))
			last := coldTestReadRequest(3, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16), 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			if name == "query-ignored-headers" {
				last = coldTestQueryRequest(3, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xab}, 16), 6)
				coldTestSetLineage(create, 701, 801)
			}
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(last[16:], 4)
			coldTestSetLineage(last, ^uint64(0), ^uint32(0))
			if name == "query-ignored-headers" {
				coldTestSetLineage(last, 702, 802)
			}
			c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(tree, create, last), nil)
			if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			allocated := c.pending[2].lineage
			if allocated == nil || allocated.known {
				t.Fatal("request parsing guessed the unobserved tree allocation")
			}
			treeBody := make([]byte, 16)
			treeBody[2] = 1
			treeReply := coldTestPacket(3, 1, true, treeBody)
			file := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x19}, 16)
			createReply := coldTestCreateResponse(o, 2, file, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, true)
			lastReply := coldTestReadResponse(3, o.state.Content)
			if name == "query-ignored-headers" {
				lastReply = coldTestQueryResponse(3, binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(nil, o.state.Reference.Attr.ID))
			}
			if name == "failed-tree" {
				body := []byte{9, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
				treeReply = coldTestPacket(3, 1, true, body)
				createReply = coldTestPacket(5, 2, true, body)
				lastReply = coldTestPacket(8, 3, true, body)
			}
			for index, packet := range [][]byte{treeReply, createReply, lastReply} {
				coldTestSetLineage(packet, 47, 313)
				if index > 0 {
					binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[16:], 5)
				}
				if name == "failed-tree" {
					coldTestSetLineage(packet, 47, 0)
					binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[8:], 0xc0000022)
				}
			}
			coldTestFeed(c, true, coldTestFrame(treeReply, createReply, lastReply), 7)
			if err := coldTestError(o); err != nil || len(c.pending) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("valid allocation lineage rejected: err=%v pending=%v", err, c.pending)
			}
			wantTree := uint32(313)
			if name == "failed-tree" {
				wantTree = 0
				if o.smbTree || o.smbOpen || o.smbRead {
					t.Fatal("error lineage credited successful work")
				}
			} else if !o.smbTree || !o.smbOpen {
				t.Fatal("successful allocation chain lost its observed tree/open")
			}
			if !allocated.known || allocated.sessionID != 47 || allocated.treeID != wantTree {
				t.Fatal("related request did not inherit the validated response")
			}
			if name == "read-sentinel-headers" && !o.smbRead {
				t.Fatal("valid related READ was not observed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdSMBLineageAllocationExceptionsAreCommandSpecific(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name                               string
		command                            uint16
		requestSession, responseSession    uint64
		requestTree, responseTree, status  uint32
		accepted, authenticated, connected bool
	}{
		{name: "initial-session-success", command: 1, responseSession: 47, accepted: true, authenticated: true},
		{name: "initial-session-more-processing", command: 1, responseSession: 47, status: 0xc0000016, accepted: true},
		{name: "initial-session-error-allocated", command: 1, responseSession: 47, status: 0xc0000022, accepted: true},
		{name: "initial-session-error-unallocated", command: 1, status: 0xc0000022, accepted: true},
		{name: "initial-session-success-missing-id", command: 1},
		{name: "initial-session-more-processing-missing-id", command: 1, status: 0xc0000016},
		{name: "existing-session-success", command: 1, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, accepted: true, authenticated: true},
		{name: "existing-session-more-processing", command: 1, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, status: 0xc0000016, accepted: true},
		{name: "existing-session-more-processing-cannot-change", command: 1, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 48, status: 0xc0000016},
		{name: "existing-session-cannot-change", command: 1, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 48},
		{name: "existing-session-error-cannot-change", command: 1, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 48, status: 0xc0000022},
		{name: "session-setup-cannot-change-tree", command: 1, responseSession: 47, responseTree: 29},
		{name: "tree-allocation", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, responseTree: 313, accepted: true, connected: true},
		{name: "tree-ignores-request-tree-on-success", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, requestTree: 29, responseTree: 313, accepted: true, connected: true},
		{name: "tree-success-missing-id", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47},
		{name: "tree-cannot-change-session", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 48, responseTree: 313},
		{name: "tree-error-retains-id", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, requestTree: 29, responseTree: 29, status: 0xc0000022, accepted: true},
		{name: "tree-error-cannot-allocate", command: 3, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, responseTree: 313, status: 0xc0000022},
		{name: "echo-cannot-allocate-session", command: 13, responseSession: 47},
		{name: "echo-cannot-allocate-tree", command: 13, requestSession: 47, responseSession: 47, responseTree: 313},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			request := coldTestPacket(test.command, 1, false, make([]byte, 24))
			body := make([]byte, 16)
			body[2] = 1
			response := coldTestPacket(test.command, 1, true, body)
			coldTestSetLineage(request, test.requestSession, test.requestTree)
			coldTestSetLineage(response, test.responseSession, test.responseTree)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(response[8:], test.status)
			c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(request), nil)
			c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
			if err := coldTestError(o); (err == nil) != test.accepted {
				t.Fatalf("allocation result=%v, expected accepted=%v", err, test.accepted)
			}
			if o.smbSession != test.authenticated || o.smbTree != test.connected {
				t.Fatalf("allocation/error credited wrong work: session=%v tree=%v", o.smbSession, o.smbTree)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestColdSMBRelatedRequestRequiresPrecedingLineage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, command := range []uint16{5, 8, 13} {
		t.Run(strconv.Itoa(int(command)), func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			packet := coldTestCreateRequest(1, o.state.SentinelName)
			if command == 8 {
				packet = coldTestReadRequest(1, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xff}, 16), 0, 1)
			}
			if command == 13 {
				packet = coldTestPacket(13, 1, false, []byte{4, 0, 0, 0})
			}
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[16:], 4)
			coldTestSetLineage(packet, ^uint64(0), ^uint32(0))
			c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(packet), nil)
			if coldTestError(o) == nil || len(c.pending) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("first related request invented a lineage")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("response-before-allocation", func(t *testing.T) {
		o := coldTestObserver(t)
		c, _ := coldTestConnection(t, o)
		tree := coldTestPacket(3, 1, false, make([]byte, 8))
		coldTestSetLineage(tree, 47, 0)
		create := coldTestCreateRequest(2, o.state.SentinelName)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(create[16:], 4)
		coldTestSetLineage(create, ^uint64(0), ^uint32(0))
		c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(tree, create), nil)
		response := coldTestCreateResponse(o, 2, bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x19}, 16), o.state.Reference.Attr.ID, false)
		coldTestSetLineage(response, 47, 313)
		c.feed(true, coldTestFrame(response), nil)
		if coldTestError(o) == nil || o.smbOpen || len(c.pending) != 2 {
			t.Fatal("response guessed an unobserved allocation")
		}
	})
}

func TestColdSMBAsyncIsObservedAndRefusedWithoutTreeDecoding(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"async-request", "async-pending", "async-final", "sync-pending"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := coldTestObserver(t)
			c, base := coldTestConnection(t, o)
			file := coldTestOpen(t, o, c)
			request := coldTestReadRequest(4, file, 0, uint32(len(o.state.Content)))
			response := coldTestReadResponse(4, o.state.Content)
			packet, out := response, true
			if name == "async-request" {
				packet, out = request, false
			} else {
				c.feed(false, coldTestFrame(request), nil)
			}
			const asyncID = uint64(0x12345678aabbccdd)
			if name != "sync-pending" {
				flags := uint32(2)
				if out {
					flags |= 1
				}
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[16:], flags)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(packet[32:40], asyncID)
			}
			if name == "async-pending" || name == "sync-pending" {
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[8:], 0x103)
			}
			frame := coldTestFrame(packet)
			if out {
				if n, err := c.Write(frame); n != len(frame) || err != nil || !bytes.Equal(base.output.Bytes(), frame) {
					t.Fatalf("unsupported async changed forwarded bytes: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
				}
			} else {
				c.feed(false, frame, nil)
			}
			if coldTestError(o) == nil || o.smbRead {
				t.Fatal("unsupported asynchronous traffic was credited")
			}
			found := false
			for _, event := range coldTestEvents(t, o) {
				if event["message_id"] != json.Number("4") || event["observation_error"] == nil {
					continue
				}
				found = true
				if _, hasTree := event["tree_id"]; hasTree {
					t.Fatal("asynchronous or pending layout was decoded as a TreeID")
				}
				if name != "sync-pending" && event["async_id"] != json.Number(strconv.FormatUint(asyncID, 10)) {
					t.Fatal("AsyncID evidence was lost")
				}
				if name == "sync-pending" {
					if _, invented := event["async_id"]; invented {
						t.Fatal("synchronous pending header invented an AsyncID")
					}
				}
			}
			if !found {
				t.Fatal("unsupported async traffic was not recorded")
			}
		})
	}
}
